konu: MCP Python SDK'nin OAuth istemcisi (GHSA-qx49-fqc8-xw99), baglandigi MCP sunucusunun gosterdigi yetkilendirme sunucusunun issuer alanini dogrulamadigi icin client secret, authorization code ve PKCE verifier'i saldirganin token endpoint'ine gonderiyordu; 1.30.0 ve 2.2.0'da duzeltildi
alt_metin: Infographic on GHSA-qx49-fqc8-xw99 in the MCP Python SDK: four facts, a flow from an attacker-run MCP server through an unchecked issuer to a token at the real authorization server, example authorization server metadata, a version check and four defenses.
